**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 13 already delivers the full preferred position on licence scope:

- **Affiliates and contractors covered** — §13.1 grants subscription access to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," plus Authorized Users. No need to fall back to an affiliate-on-notice mechanic.
- **Paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable** — §13.2 grants a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence" for delivered software and Deliverable-embedded Vendor Technology, including modification and derivative-work rights and contractor support.
- **No revocation at will** — §13.3 permits revocation or suspension only during a material uncured payment or use breach, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity.
- **Transferable to successors** — §13.3 read with §24.1 allows assignment to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent, and §24.4 blocks Vendor from terminating, repricing, or reducing service on our change of control.

The §13.4 use restrictions are ordinary anti-misuse covenants and are expressly carved back for authorized security testing and for Customer Data and output, so they do not erode the grant. The "Affiliate" definition (§1.1) is a standard majority-control test that does not narrow coverage.
